title: 私の犬
summary: A short story about a playful family dog named Pochi.
paragraphs: 私の家には犬がいます。名前はポチです。ポチは白くて、とても元気な犬です。
毎朝、私はポチと公園を散歩します。ポチはボールが大好きで、いつも走ります。
夜、ポチは私のそばで寝ます。ポチは私の大切な友達です。

grammar.explanation: います states the existence of living things (animals, people).
grammar.exampleEn: There is a dog at home.

grammar.explanation: と marks a companion: 'with'. ポチと散歩します = walk with Pochi.
grammar.exampleEn: I take a walk with Pochi.

paragraphsEn: There is a dog at my house. His name is Pochi. Pochi is white and full of energy.
Every morning, I walk Pochi in the park. He loves his ball and is always running.
At night, Pochi sleeps beside me. He is my precious friend.
